x-test.why: This is the part of v0.2's Bounded Output that survives as advice rather than law. A bounded command cannot dump an unbounded amount of context, so it is conformant, but nine fields per record with no way to ask for three still spends an agent's context on columns it did not want. The warning says so without failing a tool that is correct.
